Definition: from G3650 and G5056; complete to the end, i.e. absolutely perfect:--wholly.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, holotelḗs means wholly. It occurs just once, in 1 Thessalonians.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe holotelḗs needs no more than its plain sense — wholly.
